results.title: Resentment
results.overview: A man walks into a bar to talk about a film. Another man waits to get him to confess. A woman watches to see that he doesn't. Over the course of a long, booze-filled night, everyone is going to say what someone doesn't want to hear.

results.title: Tether
results.overview: Three years after a school shooting that took his daughter’s life, a grieving father crosses paths with the clinically depressed ex-school resource officer who froze on the fateful day. As their paths collide and their downward spirals converge, what darkness will their encounter unleash?

results.title: OSN: I Folk Songs diretti da Treviño per il centenario della nascita di Luciano Berio
results.original_title: OSN: I Folk Songs diretti da Treviño per il centenario della nascita di Luciano Berio
results.overview: From the “Arturo Toscanini” Auditorium in Turin, to celebrate the centenary of Luciano Berio’s birth, the RAI National Symphony Orchestra and its principal guest conductor Robert Treviño present “Folk Songs” for voice and orchestra, performed by mezzo-soprano Justina Gringytė. The second half of the evening features Dmitri Shostakovich’s Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43: one of the Russian composer’s most emblematic and experimental works.

results.title: The Space Between Attack and Decay
results.original_title: The Space Between Attack and Decay
results.overview: A solitary sailing scientist, assigned to resurrect a drowning world, abandons his task in order to chase the enchanting allure of a shiny object.

results.title: The Emancipation of Mimi
results.overview: Miguel is 9 years old and obsessed with singer Mariah Carey. He goes to a Catholic school and one day his class is challenged by the nuns to sell calendars of the Virgin Mary. When he finds out that he won't be able to keep the profits from the calendar sales like he thought, he decides to take action. Like some kind of miracle, his favorite singer is going to perform in his hometown.

results.title: The Stop
results.overview: An ailing theater director tries to turn the lives of two random people into a production of 'Romeo and Juliet'. But what if life and play start to mix?

results.title: Thank You for Calling
results.overview: In the anonymity of an increasingly automated city, a successful but socially  struggling man finds an unexpected emotional connection through a help desk conversation. Thank You for Calling (Met Wie Spreek Ik) is a short, magical-realistic film about Rens, a director of a music venue who is on the brink of a burn-out. After an emotional breakdown, he is unexpectedly called by Herman, an unknown man on a houseboat. What starts as an uncomfortable phone call, ends in an absurd musical journey.

results.title: Comédie Queer, la scène des Outre-mer
results.original_title: Comédie Queer, la scène des Outre-mer
results.overview: Captured on May 9, 2025, at Bazaar St So—a former railway depot in the heart of Lille—Comédie Queer, la scène des Outre-mer is a stand-up show dedicated to LGBTQIA+ comedy and drag talent from France's overseas departments and regions. For an hour and a half, Tahnee, Noam Sinseau, Norma Bell, and Natacha Prudent treat the audience to a performance dedicated to pride.

results.title: Uma Musume Pretty Derby 6th EVENT The New Frontier
results.original_title: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー 6th EVENT The New Frontier
results.overview: 6th EVENT The New Frontier is an upcoming live event for Umamusume: Pretty Derby. It will have a Spring and Autumn leg and will be held at Saitama Super Arena.

results.title: Metallica: Poor Swedish Me '96
results.overview: Recorded live at Globen, Stockholm, Sweden on November 16, 1996.  Previously Unreleased. Audio is a collection of various bootlegs mixed together by Greg Fidelman. Concert Footage Edited by Brett Murray.

results.title: The Finisher
results.overview: In 2024, Jasmin Paris made history by becoming the first woman to finish the Barkley Marathons, widely known as one of the hardest races in the world and a defining test in ultrarunning and trail running. With over 100 miles of brutal terrain, cryptic course markings, and a near-impossible success rate, the Barkley has long been considered the ultimate challenge in endurance sports. This film chronicles Jasmin’s extraordinary three-year journey (2022–2024) to achieve this groundbreaking feat and features exclusive interviews with legendary race director Lazarus Lake, ultrarunning icons Courtney Dauwalter, Amelia Boone, and Jared Campbell, as well as rare insights from Jasmin herself. Through never-before-seen footage from her home mountains in Scotland, in-depth analysis of her Barkley race strategy, and a deep dive into her endurance athlete mindset, this documentary reveals the resilience and determination behind one of the greatest achievements in ultrarunning history.

results.title: How To
results.overview: This film, inspired by true events, focuses on a young woman and her experience working in a male-dominated warehouse. Her story is told under the disguise of a standard health and safety video. In reality it’s a projection of her mind, displayed in a 1960’s style health and safety video. In this video she delves into what has occurred, hoping her experiences can be twisted into something helpful and educational, in the hopes of changing the minds of her colleagues and giving women such as herself a voice of hope.

results.title: Faux Amis
results.overview: Eleven-year-old friends Sam and Lucas embark on a quest to find "magical mushrooms", upon overhearing their uncle talk about the psychedelic wonders of the drug of the same name. Venturing through imagined forests and caves, they encounter a series of obstacles including a red-cloaked bogeyman. After finding the mushrooms in all their ethereality, they return home to a surreal twist: bright red toadstools seemingly growing from the floorboards.

results.title: Grace
results.overview: The journey of Grace Gordon, a resilient transgender woman with dreams of music stardom. Set against the backdrop of 1980s Los Angeles, Grace navigates the challenges of pursuing her passion for music while confronting societal expectations and generational trauma.

results.title: The Ant
results.overview: Three men sign up to participate in a research experiment where the goal is seemingly simple - avoid an ant for 24 hours.

results.title: The Other
results.overview: A couple's relationship is about to collapse, then the wife seems to be a different person, and the relationship seems to have been eased. However, her changeable personality and various weird behaviors make him suspicious. As the romance turns into a thriller, it turns out that the truth is not as it seems.

results.title: The Boulet Brothers' Holiday of Horrors
results.original_title: The Boulet Brothers' Holiday of Horrors
results.overview: The Boulet Brothers and David Dastmalchian present a chilling holiday-themed anthology horror special featuring four original shorts, each written and directed by a different genre powerhouse: The Boulet Brothers, Dastmalchian, Akeela Cooper, and Kate Siegel.

results.title: The Saint Antoine
results.overview: After a long journey, the Saint Antoine ship arrives at the International Space Station, but something is wrong. No response from the crew, the last transmission sent from the ship was an emergency signal from 8 hours ago, after which the ship was put on autopilot to reach their destination. Their mission was to transport a mysterious cargo
